title: How Far Can Sharpness and Complexity Jointly Explain Generalization?
abstract: arXiv:2606.29043v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale empirical studies have revealed that many widely used generalization measures correlate only weakly with generalization, suggesting that relying on a single factor is insufficient to explain it. In this work, we examine sharpness and complexity jointly, placing the reach of the two-factor view at the center: how far can they jointly explain generalization, what determines when they succeed, and where do they fall short? We investigate these questions quantitatively, using sixteen alternative metric pairs as probes and Pareto analysis and linear regression as evaluation tools. Our results show that suitably defined $(S,C)$ pairs provide strong explanatory power across a range of settings. The sharpness perturbation scale substantially affects this success, and the complexity representation influences its robustness. translated_title: 锐度与复杂度能在多大程度上共同解释泛化？
translated_abstract: 大规模实证研究表明，许多广泛使用的泛化度量与泛化能力仅呈弱相关，这表明仅依赖单一因素不足以解释泛化。在本工作中，我们联合考察锐度与复杂度这两个因素，并将双因素视角的适用范围作为核心问题：它们能在多大程度上共同解释泛化？什么决定了它们何时成功？它们又在哪里失效？我们以定量的方式研究这些问题，使用十六种替代度量对作为探针，并采用帕累托分析和线性回归作为评估工具。我们的结果表明，恰当定义的$(S,C)$度量对在一系列设置中都表现出很强的解释力。锐度扰动尺度对这种成功有显著影响，而复杂度的表示方式则影响其鲁棒性。剩余的失败案例留下了一个悬而未决的问题：更精细的度量是否足够，还是需要引入额外的因素。
tldr: 本文定量研究了锐度与复杂度联合解释深度学习泛化能力的上限，发现恰当定义的度量对具有很强的解释力，其成功受锐度扰动尺度和复杂度表示方式的影响，但仍有失效情况，暗示可能需要额外因素。
en_tdlr: This paper quantitatively explores how far sharpness and complexity can jointly explain generalization, showing that suitably defined (S,C) metric pairs provide strong explanatory power, with perturbation scale and complexity representation being key, while remaining failures suggest additional factors may be needed.
